name: Licorice + Yellow Silk Cotton + Mastic tree
indication_description:
This is indicated in-
  • Hyperacidity
  • Gastric ulcer
  • Duodenal ulcer
pharmacology_description: This is a unique combination of Licorice (Glycyrrhiza glabra), Yellow Silk Cotton (Cochiospermum religiosum) and other precious natural ingredients. It is very effective in hyperacidity, gastric ulcer & duodenal ulcer.
dosage_description: 1 teaspoonful 3 times daily before meal or as prescribed by the physician.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been observed in proper dosage.
precautions_description: Keep out of reach of the children.
storage_conditions_description: Store at cool and dry place, protect from light.
